text:
deploy-bot: Canary safety hold triggered for release v2.8.0 at 2024-02-17T15:10Z. Reason: p95 latency > 1.1s and error-rate spike > 3% on /generate. Suggested action: HOLD rollout, rollback canary slice to v2.7.1, notify customers. Auto-pin will execute in 10m unless manual action taken. Related: https://deployments.redwood.ai/runs/98765 :warning:

Jordan: seeing the same in grafana, p95 climbed to ~1.45s. Errors are 503s clustered to tokenizer shard requests. :eyes:

Priya: digging into logs — I'm seeing OOM traces on gpu-3 around 15:07, plus a pair of failed kvcache reads. Might be memory regression in the new kernel.

Mateo: I can execute a manual rollback/pin. prefer manual pin -> gives us control for comms and postmortem.

Kim (oncall): +1 manual rollback. We'll notify Dedicated customers proactively. I'll draft customer messaging.

Ava (product): include change window note and that we're pausing rollout; flag release notes publish as "on hold" until RCA.

Li (eng-mgr): agreed. Mateo, please run the pin and confirm. Keep canary slices frozen and don't resume auto-unhold.

Mateo: running command now: ```infra deploy pin --release=v2.7.1 --scope=canary --reason="canary safety hold: tokenizer OOM"``` Will follow-up when traffic flips.

deploy-bot: Pin command accepted. Executing traffic shift for canary slice to v2.7.1. Auto-unhold timer suspended due to manual intervention.

Jordan: metrics update: p95 back to 0.95s, error-rate down to baseline. Looks stable so far.

Kim (oncall): Comms drafted for status page and Dedicated CSMs: "We've paused the v2.8.0 rollout after observing increased latency and transient OOMs. Canary traffic was reverted to v2.7.1. No customer data impacted. Investigating; will follow up with RCA." Shall I post now? :email:

Priya: please do post. I'm collecting logs and reproducer; assigning follow-up to @Mateo for kernel/quantization regression.

Mateo: logs uploaded to ticket INF-3421: https://issues.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3421. I'll bisect the quantization change from the v2.8.0 build.

Ava (product): thanks — holding release notes and changelog publish until we confirm root cause.

Li (eng-mgr): mark release status = BLOCKED in the tracker and schedule a 30m sync once Mateo has initial findings.

deploy-bot: Note: auto-unhold timeout was 10m; it's disabled after manual pin. To resume rollout use `deploybot unhold --release=v2.8.0` after RCA and a manual thumbs-up from product + eng oncall.

Kim (oncall): I've sent the status update to #status and pinged Dedicated contacts. Will update #eng-releases when we have an RCA or ETA.

Jordan: SGTM. Good catch by the canary thresholds.

Mateo: will report back in ~25m with bisect progress.

Ava (product): copy — we'll prepare internal release messaging template in case we need to communicate to wider customers.

Li (eng-mgr): thanks everyone. After RCA, decide: 1) fix-on-v2.8 + re-roll, or 2) revert permanently and iterate. Keep notes for postmortem.
